title: Два хозяина и два банкета  (Two Owners and Two Banquets)

scenes.title: Пустота в душе  (Emptiness in the Soul)
scenes.summary: Max tries to fill the emptiness after his breakup, but a vision of Vika scolds him and ruins his morning.

scenes.title: Два владельца ресторана  (Two Restaurant Owners)
scenes.summary: Kristina demands a million for her share of the restaurant, leaving her and Nagiyev as equal co-owners.

scenes.title: Кто здесь главный?  (Who Is the Boss Here?)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Kristina give contradictory orders about the champagne, while Kostya advises Max on how to forget Vika.

scenes.title: Двойная игра Шефа  (The Chef's Double Game)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov plays both owners to win a twenty percent raise from Nagiyev, while Max meets a girl named Masha at a club.

scenes.title: Не та квартира  (The Wrong Apartment)
scenes.summary: Max brings Masha to Vika's apartment by mistake, thinking Vika is another hallucination until she throws Masha out.

scenes.title: Неожиданный визит Нагиева  (Nagiyev's Unexpected Visit)
scenes.summary: Vika orders Max to get dressed and hide in the bathroom when Nagiyev arrives at her apartment door.

scenes.title: Прятки в ванной  (Hiding in the Bathroom)
scenes.summary: Vika answers Kostya's call on Max's phone, brings it to the bathroom, and slips on the wet floor.

scenes.title: Мужчина в ванной  (A Man in the Bathroom)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev discovers Max in Vika's bathroom in his underwear, and Vika swears they are just friends.

scenes.title: Шпинат в сливках  (Spinach in Cream)
scenes.summary: Kristina orders vegetarian spinach added to the menu, Nagiyev bans it, and Chef Barinov tricks Kristina into canceling her own idea.

scenes.title: Уволен и принят обратно  (Fired and Rehired)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev fires Max at his table, Kristina immediately rehires him to spite Nagiyev, and Kristina's lawyer suddenly passes away.

scenes.title: Спор о спецобслуживании  (Fight Over Private Service)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Kristina storm into the kitchen and argue fiercely over whose private event will close the restaurant tomorrow.

scenes.title: Двойное обещание Виктора Петровича  (Viktor Petrovich's Double Promise)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov takes an advance deposit from Kristina for her event and then promises Nagiyev he will host his friend's birthday too.

scenes.title: Пятно от соуса  (The Sauce Stain)
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov tells Vika they will run one banquet in the hall and one on the terrace, before Max spills sauce on Vika.

scenes.title: Серьёзные планы Нагиева  (Nagiyev's Serious Plans)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev catches Max helping Vika with her stained blouse and tells Max that he has serious plans for Vika.

scenes.title: Перед грозой  (Before the Thunderstorm)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev warns Max to step aside, and the next day rain threatens the outdoor banquet on the summer terrace.

scenes.title: Ливень и два банкета в одном зале  (Downpour and Two Banquets in One Hall)
scenes.summary: Heavy rain forces the funeral wake from the terrace into the main hall right next to the loud birthday banquet.

scenes.title: Скандал между гостями  (Scandal Between Guests)
scenes.summary: The two groups of banquet guests clash in the dining room while Vika and Max scramble to keep the peace.

scenes.title: Приезд обоих хозяев  (Both Owners Arrive)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev and Kristina confront each other and Chef Barinov over the double-booked banquets as a fight breaks out.

scenes.title: Признание Нагиева  (Nagiyev's Confession)
scenes.summary: Vika defends Max when Nagiyev threatens to fire him, and Nagiyev sincerely confesses his feelings for Vika.

scenes.title: Новый сюжет  (A New Storyline)
scenes.summary: Nagiyev asks Vika for a chance and spares Max's job, while Max reflects on starting a new storyline in his life.
